summary: Extends SCTP so an endpoint can tell its peer to move the cumulative ack point forward, giving a partially reliable service to upper layers. It adds a new parameter to INIT and INIT ACK and a new FORWARD TSN chunk. It also gives one example of such a service.

eli5.summary: Sometimes old data is not worth waiting for. This lets a sender say, forget the lost piece, move on, for things like live video.
